report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED]. Pain at the medial and posterior aspects. Associated popping/clicking, locking, buckling, and swelling.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Type I bipartite patella.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full-thickness fissuring at the peripheral lateral femoral condyle with subchondral edema. The tibial plateau cartilage is preserved.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness chondrosis at the median ridge and high-grade partial-thickness chondrosis at the medial patellar facet. Focal full-thickness fissuring at the trochlear notch with subchondral edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 4 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Mild edema in the partially imaged anterior tibial compartment muscles. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Prepatellar soft tissue edema.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Partially imaged mild intramuscular edema within the proximal anterior tibial muscle compartment could reflect low-grade muscle strain or contusion given the provided history.
2.	Mild patellar tendinosis. 
3.	Patellofemoral and lateral compartment chondrosis.
4.	Small prepatellar soft tissue contusion.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs ve medial menisküs normaldir. Medial menisküs gövde kesiminde bütünlük kaybı ve posterior hornunda horizontal yırtık ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlenmiştir. Medial menisküs laterale ekstrüdedir.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Retropatellar ve femoral kartilajda kondromalazi ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri mevcuttur.Distal kuadriseps ve diğer patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Suprapatellar bursada ve diz eklem aralığında minimal effüzyon mevcuttur.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.

Findings: Mild - moderate knee effusion is noted. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Osteophyte formation is noted in all three compartments. Minimal fraying is seen in the medial and lateral compartment articular cartilage. No cartilage loss.  T T T G distance is widened and measures 18 mm. There is mild - moderate patellofemoral dysplasia. Lateralization of the patella is noted with resulting severe lateral patellofemoral degeneration and complete cartilage loss.  
Conclusion: Patellar maltracking with severe lateral patellofemoral degeneration.

Findings:  There is a minor knee effusion. There is an oblique inferior surfacing tear of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Focal articular cartilage edema is noted in the lateral patellar facet but no cartilage loss. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Tear of the posteromedial corner of the medial meniscus.

Geringe mediale Gonarthrose mit in der Belastungszone flächig gemindertem Knorpelbesatz beider Gelenkpartner. Oberflächliche Chondropathie auch retropatellar, betont am Patellafirst (4/12). Keine vollschichtige Chondropathie, keine wesentliche Chondropathie im lateralen femorotibialen Gelenkkompartiment. Bandapparat intakt. Meniscen intakt, allenfalls Innenmeniskushinterhorn gering mukoid. Physiologisches Knochenmarksignal. Kein Gelenkerguss. Miterfasste periartikuläre Weichteile in vorliegender Sequenzwahl ohne nennenswerte Pathologie.

There is no significant knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, LCL. There is mild - moderate thickening and edema of the proximal half of MCL but no evidence of rupture. Appearances would be in keeping with a grade II sprain. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is unremarkable. A small intra-articular ganglion is noted in the anteromedial aspect of the joint.  
Conclusion: Grade II MCL sprain. No meniscal tear.

Keine Fraktur. Kreuzbänder intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Zysten angrenzend dem Vorderhorn des Innenmeniskus, DD synoviale Zysten oder Ganglionzysten. Initiale mukoide Degeneration der Hinterhörner, keine eindeutige umschriebene Rissbildung. Geringe Chondropathie medial femorotibial in der Tragzone, im Übrigen keine tiefergreifende Chondropathie in allen Gelenkkompartimenten. Enthesiopathische Veränderungen der Quadricepssehne.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE]  [TIME]
Indication: sprain of right knee; 3-4 weeks of right knee pain after fall/slipped playing football
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Osseous contusions of the proximal tibia and fibula at the tibiofibular articulation. No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 15 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Osseous contusions of the proximal tibiofibular articulation.

There is normal knee joint alignment.   No fracture or bone contusion is seen.  
 No osteocartilagenous lesion is detected.  
 No focal bone marrow edema is noted.  
 Minimal amount of joint effusion is seen.  
 MCL is intact    Medial meniscus is not torn.  
 FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.       
 Normal shape with preserved signal of the lateral meniscus is observed.   
 Normal course with preserved signal of the ACL is noted.  The PCL is intact  
 The PF joint surface is preserved.   No subchondral bone lesion is noted.  
 The quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.    No definite cartilagenous lesion. 
   No definite ligamentous tear. 
   No definite 1

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Condropatía medial. Obs. Edema óseo.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Fibrilación marginal del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco lateral.
Rotura compleja del cuerno anterior, cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial , con
maceración y extrusión meniscal.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial
medial con proliferaciones óseas periféricas. Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total de la
región central del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Cartílago troclear sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total del vértice de la
rótula con cambios óseos secundarios.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendón rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial sin alteraciones.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.
Impresión:
Fibrilación marginal del menisco lateral.
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con maceración y extrusión.
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 y 4 del compartimento femorotibial medial. Condropatía lesiones
grado 2 y 3 del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Condropatía lesiones focales grado 4 de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular
